analysis.reasonEn: RSI has moved out of oversold territory into neutral, but MACD histogram shows improvement without confirming a trend change. 5-day volatility is mixed (+4.51%, +0.35%, -7.02%, +6.63%, -3.20%), indicating directionless movement. ADX at 29.4 suggests no clear trend is forming.

· Current phase diagnosis (Accumulation) + entry conditions not met, maintaining a wait-and-see stance.

ADX at 29.4 suggests no established trend; caution against chasing momentum if volatility increases.
